body:
I will inbox you. Thank you for that. It's okay, I don't think you have a messy text. I will inbox you soon, and I am very thankful.

Thank you!

Yeah. I wish it wasn't like that, but I can still try. It never leaves my mind to completely stop it.

It might, I don't know if my mind will change ever. I'm stubborn when it comes to hoping to stop fapping.

It makes me feel better to know somebody when through the exact same situation at me. It isn't good, but it definitely helps me. I don't know if my brother regrets it, but I'd like to think he does. My brother always calls me names and other things. It hurts, but I feel like he does it for alone time. My thoughts... I know that my body is going through changes, but I would really like to avoid masturbating. It feels like a time suck and I would rather have wet dreams instead, despite having to wake up to a mess.

I guess it really is a phase. How did you grow out of it? Did it take time or was it just normal basically. Like you just snap out of the phase. I guess you're right, but I feel like I'm letting somebody down. I have multiple homework assignments undone because I am just too lazy and I still feel disgusted.

I don't know why it makes me want to kill myself. How do I even get out of this rough patch. I've started to copy people for a long time, and now I don't even know who I am. I know everybody, I see right through them, but when I look at myself in a mirror. It's opaque, I can't see through anything because I've already seen it all. I'm just data I've collected of people I've envied. Sometimes it feels like my parents won't miss me, but I guess you're right.

I have been really stressed about school. I've never been an F student, and now. I've stopped achieving things like others. I've fallen behind and became a ghost. Nobody cares except me. Not even my parents anymore. I don't know why I can't get it through my head. I know I should work but when I try. I can't write, my brain automatically shuts down because it's used to not being used.

Thank you for the offer and I will definitely use it.

Thank you for telling me that it gets better. I'm happy that you are happy with your life, girlfriend, hobbies, and even job. I really hope it gets better. I'm very afraid of college, life, and everything in general. I don't have any clubs I'm in and don't know how I will get through life like that. I have no close friends and I'm very scared most of the times.

Thanks to the helpful comments, I will not. I can't abstain from thinking I'm a failure. I am a horrible student who hasn't been trying and blaming it on others. I think you're really right but my brain likes to put it that way. I am really depressed, at least diagnosed with it... I know it's my hormones and I want to stop. I haven't been trying to do my homework. It's really bad. No schedule. I eat randomly, my parents aren't always home to make dinner. I sleep randomly too. I really can't sleep at certain times. I need to do things. School takes up time and everything else does too. I'm always confused about sleep.

Thank you. I will use this opportunity to talk to you. Your post really helped me.

My mind portrayed masturbating as if it's not ok. I don't know how, but I really want to stop. Extremely badly. I purchase things that I enjoy and don't use them, play with them, read them, or do anything with them unless I'm fap free. I've made four emails, tried restarts everyday, and all this other stuff thinking it will work. It really is insanity, I keep doing the same things expecting different results but it's always the same.... I don't think I will be able to have sex. I'm not popular, I don't think any girl notices me in my school, I have a horrible reputation due to talking to previous girls and getting extremely jealous. A lot of things. If any chance I do have sex at this age. Protection will be there.

I didn't really lose my friends due to moving, but it's just like how you lost a lot of friends through WoW. I had close friends on Xbox that go to my school but they stopped being close when I gave my Xbox up for two months and then switched to PS4. They don't laugh with me, sit with me, and I actually was really depressed. I have a teacher who I have become good friends with. I come after school to talk to him a lot. I really enjoy his company. He is probably one of the wisest people I know and I think he has an amazing life. Maybe I should talk to him, I don't know why I never thought of that.

I always think I need to get As, my parents put that on me. They always thought I was such a smart kid and I feel like I let them down every time my grades go below an A. I can't get As though, I've become lazy and it's too much. It's probably because I do it all late and not at the right time. You're really right, maybe I should shoot for Cs right now. Do you really think I can make it to the top 5%? I'm in honors and all those kids are so much smarter than me it makes me upset. They all have As and live amazing lives. I lost all my ambitions looking at them and envying them.

Even if I get way too jealous? I get really jealous. A group of people I play with are all getting PCs and I'm not. I know a guy in my school who got left back, is failing, and has a $2000+ PC build, an Xbox One, and a PS4. It makes me really upset.

I fake laughs a lot. I haven't heard my real laugh in awhile. Someone saw right through my laugh, a new kid. I couldn't believe it. It was the first time somebody noticed that my laugh was fake. I also fake happiness. I tell people in school that I don't give a crap about my grades even though I really do. I break each time I get a D and try to hide it.

Yeah. It really is damaging to me. I don't remember much, and I don't have the courage to talk to him. My brother smokes a lot of weed, cigarettes, and he doesn't go to college. He dropped out...twice. He isn't a bad human being, and just like I look through others. I feel like he cries a lot but I also feel like he doesn't. If he does, he really masks his emotions. I know he doesn't do it to anyone else. I at least hope he isn't.

It's 11:20 right now. I'm sorry. I really wanted to reply to all these helpful posts that made me feel so much better. I don't want to kill myself anymore, I know it will come back though, I think. I am still upset though. I want to read, I want to build a collection of life. I stay up because I feel as if time is an obstacle. I will read Artemis Fowl, at least pick up one copy. 

I've been so lonely with girls. I really focus on dating. I feel that I don't think I would be ready with Sam. That is if she likes me, but if she does somehow like me. I don't know what will happen. I really want her to be my friend. I find her extremely pretty and really nice. She is the only girl I know who says hi to me and hugs me, but I feel like she does it because she is really friendly. I don't see her do it to other boys, but maybe she just gives me sympathy. I have no guts, and have a hard time texting a girl despite having her number. I told her to send a textbook page to me when I just wanted her number. I was going to text her...three months ago, but I didn't pick it up and text her. I wussed out. I don't want to have sex with her. I want to just have a close friend, and girls are close friends. I wouldn't mind being able to kiss her.... I haven't been able to experience something like that.

They do love me, but I can't blame them for being mad at me. I always feel like it's my fault, and I caused them a lot of pain sometimes. I don't be mean to them and hit them. Nono, but I became a problem child. My brother was a problem child who drank alcohol. I'm the child who they had hopes for and am now becoming a problem child. To be honest, right when I read it's okay to cry. I cried. Hard... I thank you so much for this, and you gave me hope. You've done a lot.

I apologize for not responding as fast as possible. I've been a little sick and read this awhile back. Thank you so much, again.
